Majestic Accessory

Majestic Accessory is a hat accessory crafted by the Trapper in Red Dead Redemption 2. It takes 4 Rooster Feather, 2 Songbird Feather and 2 Woodpecker Feather and costs $15.00. Part of Trapper's Hat Collection.

Type

Vendor

Set

Price

Ingredients

  • 2xSongbird Feather
  • 2xWoodpecker Feather
